description: Angular component for entity filtering in the Thingsboard UI, managing form controls, filter types, and emitting filter changes.

classes.name: EntityFilterComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor for entity filtering with dynamic form controls and filter logic.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes filter types, entity types, and form groups, sets up subscriptions for form control changes.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions and subjects to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for propagating changes to parent form.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Disables or enables the component based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates form controls with provided filter data.

methods.name: updateFilterFormGroup
methods.description: Dynamically creates form controls based on selected filter type.

methods.name: filterTypeChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in filter type, updates resolveMultiple flag and form controls.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Constructs filter object from form values and propagates change.
